projects.subtitle: // artefacts.log — clearance: public
projects.description: Each project is an artefact — built from scratch, owned completely, no dependencies on rented infrastructure.

hazoom-os.title: HAZOOM OS
hazoom-os.desc: A complete Unix-like operating system built from scratch. Pascal monolithic kernel with process manager, memory manager, file system, device drivers, and security layer. 70+ integrated applications including AI copilot, browser, and neural interface. Deployed on K3s with zero-downtime rolling updates.

mario-gta6.title: Super Mario GTA6
mario-gta6.desc: Original 3D open-world game engine fusing platformer mechanics with GTA freedom. Rust physics compiled to WebAssembly (60 FPS in browser), Three.js WebGL rendering with dynamic lighting, ECS architecture with AI behavior trees, spatial audio, and procedural world generation. 27,000+ source files.

neon-drift.title: Neon Drift
neon-drift.desc: Retro-futuristic hover-racer with synthwave aesthetics. Custom physics engine, drift mechanics, AI opponents with pathfinding, and a procedural track generator. Built with zero dependencies — pure WebGL rendering pipeline.

maps.title: HAZEM Maps
maps.desc: Real-time mapping and geospatial visualization platform. Interactive maps with POI data, route optimization, and location intelligence. Built for privacy-first navigation without cloud dependency.

hazoom-kernel.title: HAZOOM Kernel
hazoom-kernel.desc: Custom C kernel with memory management, interrupt handling, and syscall interface. Designed for the HAZOOM OS ecosystem. Implements quantum-resistant cryptography primitives and Q-learning in kernel space.

alphapony-engine.title: AlphaPony AI Engine
alphapony-engine.desc: Autonomous AI agent trained on personal creative patterns for code generation and game design assistance. 275 Linux syscalls mapped as capabilities. Syscall atlas visualization with galaxy metaphor. Self-learning architecture with episodic memory.
